news_trading: Restricted: on Standard FTMO (funded) accounts, no order execution 2 minutes before or after selected high-impact news on affected instruments. Challenge/Verification phases and Swing accounts are exempt
ea_bots_allowed: Allowed, within limits: platform caps of 200 open orders and 2,000 positions a day; more than 2,000 server requests a day is forbidden; third-party EAs risk breaching the max capital allocation rule
copy_trading: Restricted: third parties may not trade your account; identical trading across accounts (including from signal groups or copy services) can be suspended if it exceeds the $400,000 max capital allocation per trader/strategy
overnight_weekend_holding: Challenge/Verification phases and Swing accounts: overnight and weekend allowed. Standard FTMO Account: positions must be closed before market breaks longer than 2 hours (e.g. weekends); overnight on weekdays is allowed
restricted_countries_note: No service to residents of about 70 countries/regions, including Russia, Belarus, Iraq, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kosovo, Venezuela and occupied parts of Ukraine. Iran, Syria, Myanmar and North Korea nationals are excluded, with conditional EEA-residency exceptions for some. US clients go to ftmo.oanda.com; Australia to ftmo.com/au/. https://ftmo.com/en/faq/who-can-join-ftmo/

affiliate_program.commission: CFD products: Bronze 8%, Silver 10%, Gold 15%, Platinum 20% (one-time per product per referred trader); Futures evaluations 10-18%, resets 5-9% for up to 12 months
affiliate_program.notes: Levels are set by monthly commissions (EUR thresholds €0/€250/€1,000/€2,500). €50 payout threshold. FTMO US runs a separately tracked USD programme with the same rates.

recent_changes_2026.change: 1-Step FTMO Challenge launched (10% target, 3% daily, 10% EOD trailing max loss, 90% split, 50% Best Day rule) (reported by a third-party tracker)
1-Step: Consistency rule (best day at most 50% of total profit) replaces the Best Day Rule for new orders and merged accounts

pros: Founded 2015 in Prague; Trustpilot 4.8 from 54,479 reviews
2-Step fee is refunded with the first reward; static 10% max loss and no time limit
Swing account type (2-Step) allows news trading and weekend holding
Accepts US traders through a separate US entity (FTMO US / OANDA)
Scaling Plan of +25% every 4 months, up to $2M
cons: 2-Step default split is 80%; 90% needs Scaling Plan or Premium Programme
1-Step uses an EOD trailing max loss and a 3% daily limit; fee not refundable
Standard funded accounts restrict news trading (±2 min) and holding over market breaks longer than 2h
Prices are in EUR on the global site and in USD (different amounts) on the US site, so they are hard to compare
Simulated accounts only; no published route to a live account
best_for: Forex/CFD traders who want an established firm with a static-drawdown 2-step evaluation and a refundable fee; US traders are served through ftmo.oanda.com.
